verdict.rationale: Termius has an AI feature that converts plain-language descriptions into shell commands (termius-docs-6), directly enabling natural-language operation for command generation. However, this appears limited to command generation only, not broader natural-language control of the app (e.g., navigating hosts, managing vaults, or scripting workflows via NL), and there's no independent/community corroboration of this AI feature's quality or reliability. Missing for 10: evidence of natural-language control beyond command generation, hands-on/community validation of the AI feature, and details on scope/accuracy limitations.
